signals.name: Ben Thompson
signals.latest_title: Anthropic S-1, The Cost of Compute, Who Is Paying?
signals.summary: Thompson reads Anthropic's S-1 and finds the core business very profitable. He warns that competition could erode those profits and that investors face endless dilution. He also wrote 'The End of the Internet' (Oct 26), arguing the old Internet where anyone could host a server is over.
signals.connection: This is a direct read of today's top story, Anthropic's public Nasdaq IPO filing. It bears on AI compute economics and on how Big Tech earnings tonight will be read.

signals.name: Packy McCormick
signals.summary: A weekly roundup of optimistic news. This edition covers cancer drugs, The Nuclear Company, Warhound, consciousness and Marathon Alchemy, plus extra doses.

signals.name: Lenny Rachitsky
signals.latest_title: Why Reddit built its own AI prototyping tool | Blair Metcalf
signals.summary: A 30-minute episode in which Reddit's principal UX engineer shows a custom Figma MCP and Cursor pipeline that takes designers from a blank slate to a shareable prototype in minutes. Lenny also posted a podcast roundup on Claude Duet and an 86-minute guide to finding PMF with Rob Snyder.
signals.connection: This is applied AI tooling changing product and design work, which ties to the Labor & Workforce and Frontier Tech themes.

signals.name: Noam Brown
signals.latest_title: Concluding remarks on AI alignment at COLM 2026
signals.summary: An aggregator page says Eric Horvitz praised Brown's concluding remarks on AI alignment at COLM 2026 as insightful. The page does not say what Brown actually said.

signals.name: François Chollet
signals.latest_title: ARC Prize 2026: Tufa Labs reaches 88.06% on ARC-AGI-2
signals.summary: A secondary French-language source says ARC Prize announced on Oct 9 that Tufa Labs reached 88.06% on ARC-AGI-2, and that Chollet noted the same score on Kaggle. I couldn't confirm this against an official ARC Prize source.
signals.connection: This is a frontier-AI capability benchmark data point that bears on how much of the compute spend Anthropic's S-1 discloses is turning into real capability.
